messages:
sara: FYI customer (Org: Brightwater) just escalated — batch rerank endpoint returning fewer candidates for some queries. they sent 5 candidates per query, but results show 3 for some queries. request_id=req_0a9c
ashley: ack, can you paste the payload (sanitized) and response snippet?
sara: pasted below. note this is from their prod gzipped payload via our API gateway.

sara: ```json
{
  "queries": [
    {"id": "q1", "text": "How to reset password", "candidates": ["c1","c2","c3","c4","c5"]},
    {"id": "q2", "text": "Billing invoice 2025", "candidates": ["c6","c7","c8","c9","c10"]},
    {"id": "q3", "text": "API error 502", "candidates": ["c11","c12","c13","c14","c15"]}
  ],
  "model": "redwood-rerank-v1",
  "batch_id": "bw-2026-03-17"
}
```

sara: response (truncated):

sara: ```json
{
  "results": [
    {"query_id":"q1","scores": [0.9,0.2,0.1]},
    {"query_id":"q2","scores": [0.7,0.6,0.5,0.1,0.05]},
    {"query_id":"q3","scores": [0.4,0.3,0.2]}
  ]
}
```

leo: weird — q1 and q3 lost two scores each while q2 preserved 5. looks like per-query candidate lists are being collapsed for some positions.
ryan: any obvious pattern? e.g., every Nth query? or by candidate length?
sara: appears tied to queries that contain short texts (< 20 chars) in this payload (q1 and q3 are shorter). customer says this used to work before last week's deploy.

ashley: I reproduced locally by sending a multi-query JSON with varying query lengths. when payload size crosses ~1.2MB and gzip enabled, our unpacker returns fewer candidate arrays for some queries.
ashley: attaching local trace (sanitized):

ashley: ```
UNPACK: buf_len=1234567
PARSE: queries_count=3
LOOP: q0.candidates_len=5
LOOP: q1.candidates_len=3  <-- mismatch
LOOP: q2.candidates_len=5
```

ashley: root cause looks like boundary detection in the streaming JSON parser when handling nested arrays under high compression. some trailing comma bytes get dropped during reassembly (race in decompressor buffer refill).

leo: ok. quick mitigation — force gateway to decompress and pass uncompressed payloads to rerank service for customers hitting this. can we add a temporary rule?
ryan: yes, we can add a header check and fallback for requests with Content-Encoding: gzip and payload_size > 1e6.

sara: customer asked for repro steps they can run. ashley, can you produce a curl example they can run? keep auth token placeholder.

ashley: sharing a repro curl — note they need the exact gz compression ratio; using Python snippet to gzip makes it reliable.

ashley: ```bash
# generate payload.json (same structure), then:
python -c "import gzip,sys; gzip.open('payload.json.gz','wb').write(open('payload.json','rb').read())"
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank/batch \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  --data-binary @payload.json.gz
```

ashley: if they run that with the sample payload above, they should see the shorter score arrays.

leo: remediation plan:
- short-term: add gateway rule to decompress large gz payloads before forwarding (low-risk, quick rollback)
- mid-term: patch streaming parser to avoid buffer boundary corruption and add unit tests for nested arrays with compressed input
- long-term: add e2e test with gzipped multi-query fixtures and fuzz different chunk boundaries

sara: customer wants ETA for short-term fix — can we do it today?
ryan: I can deploy the gateway rule in next 3 hours, monitor for any perf impact. will notify support-bot when done.

support-bot: action logged: gateway-decompress-fallback created by ryan at 2108250200. linked ticket: INF-9876.

sara: thanks team; I'll update customer and recommend the temporary workaround (send uncompressed or we apply the gateway fallback). please post follow-up when the parser patch is scheduled.

leo: filed parser bug: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9880 (assigned to eng-runtime). PR plan: fix + regression tests + canary rollout.

ashley: note: also looking at whether bulk CSV imports to rerank (via our internal conversion) hit the same code path.

ryan: monitoring dashboard set for request_id=req_0a9c and batch_id=bw-2026-03-17. will report back in thread.

sara: closing loop once gateway rule is live and customer confirmed. :thumbsup:
